parts:
Hi Phil and Mirt Community, 

I created a mulitpleGroup model with the code below and then used fscores to determine the factor scores for each of my groups. However, for one of my groups I am getting very strange results...I am getting all zeros for all factors and responses in that group.  The scores for all the other groups look great. The only issue I see is the COV31 is equal to 1 and I'm stumped as to why it would be like this.  Does anything jump out to y'all as being incorrect or have any suggestions?

Thank you!
Leigh

messages.subject: Re: multipleGroup - fscore and $GroupPars COV Issue
parts:
The 1 that you are seeing could just be a rounding error in the output, but you're right it's probably somewhere close to .9999. I think this could indicate a problem with the model in that some of the traits are, at some point during the estimation, really highly correlated. I'm not really sure what to recommend here because it depends on the nature of the data, whether you can reaonably apply priors, if this relationship might have been expected, and so on. 

Phil
